Help & How-To

Got a question?

Quick answers below — and a video if you still need it.

Ready to play? Bays are available right now.

Book a Bay

Check your booking confirmation email — it contains your unique door access code. Enter the code on the keypad next to the entrance door. If you have any trouble call (205) 810-2245.

Welcome. This video walks you through everything you need to know for your first visit — from walking in to teeing off. Takes about two minutes and covers all the basics.

Press the power button on the computer tower located in the bay. Give it about 60 seconds to boot up fully then the simulator software will launch automatically.

Check that the projector is powered on — there is a power button on the projector unit above the bay. If it is on but the screen is still black try pressing the input source button until the simulator display appears.

From the main menu select Play Golf then choose Course Play. You can then browse and select any course in the library. The welcome video walks through this step by step.

Press the menu button on the simulator screen and select End Round then Start New Session to begin fresh. This clears the previous player's data completely.

You can set number of players, handicaps, tee position, and game format before starting. If you just want to jump in and play the default settings work for most groups.

Thousands of courses are available. Use the search bar in the course menu to find a specific course by name. Augusta National, Pebble Beach, St. Andrews, and thousands more are all in there.

Stroke play, match play, scramble, skins, and more. Formats are selectable when you set up your round before teeing off.

Yes. When setting up your round select the number of players and assign them to teams. Scramble and best ball formats are both available for group play.

First try closing and reopening the simulator software from the desktop. If that does not resolve it restart the computer. For anything else call (205) 810-2245 and someone will help you right away.

The data displayed includes ball speed, launch angle, spin rate, carry distance, and club path. You don't need to understand it all to play — the welcome video breaks down the most useful numbers if you want to dig in.

Aim using the alignment marker on the mat and address the ball normally. The simulator reads your actual swing — the more naturally you swing the more accurate the shot data will be.

Yes. Press the replay button on screen — it is labeled Mulligan or Replay depending on your software version. There may be a limit on replays per round depending on your game format settings.

Save your round if you want to keep your score then return all equipment to where you found it. Make sure the simulator is back on the main menu screen for the next guest. No check-out required — just head out when you're done.

Still have questions?

Call us at (205) 810-2245 or just come in. No reservation required.
